summary: A non-musical firmware that makes the FM-1 a standalone MIDI tool for monitoring, filtering, remapping and triggering MIDI without a computer. It makes no sound of its own apart from a clock click.
features: Scrolling monitor of the last 100 messages, colour-coded by what happened
Per-port channel and message-type filters; note, CC and channel remaps
Event triggers send message lists, such as bank and program changes
Knobs send CCs; keys play notes and program changes
MIDI clock monitor with metronome click on the headphone output
TRS and USB in, USB out only; 16 patches with SysEx backup
